subject: Private offer & partner pass-through plan for CloudFort
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@cloudfort.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudfort.com
Date: 2028-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer & partner pass-through plan for CloudFort

Hi Maria —

Thanks again for taking time earlier this week. Attached is our first-draft private offer for CloudFort (draft_private_offer_CloudFort_v1.pdf). Key points below so procurement has everything up front: 

- Offer term: 12 months (auto-renewable)
- List price (compute + license bundle): $380k annual list
- Proposal discount: 20% off list for first year (Candidate for committed spend)
- Channel pass-through: we can show an explicit "partner margin" line on Redwood's invoice; we'd like to align on the percentage and routing before finalizing the PO
- Marketplace listing: we can publish to GCP Marketplace once DocuSign is complete; typical lead time 5–7 business days after signature

Ask for procurement: can you confirm whether CloudFort requires the partner margin to appear as a separate line on the invoice (yes/no) and whether invoices should route through your distributor? If they want distributor routing, please share the supplier/vendor code and invoicing contact. I attached your PO template if useful (cloudfort_po_template.docx).

I'll loop in Connor and Irene from our deals team to confirm the channel pass-through mechanics if needed.

Thanks — look forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft_private_offer_CloudFort_v1.pdf, cloudfort_po_template.docx

From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@cloudfort.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudfort.com
Date: 2028-06-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & partner pass-through plan for CloudFort

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft. A few procurement items we need before we can route this to our finance team: 

1) Channel margin visibility: CloudFort requires partner margin to be shown as a separate line on the vendor invoice for pass-through accounting. Please confirm Redwood can emit an invoice with: gross list, discount, partner margin (explicit line), net payable.

2) Distributor routing: We prefer invoices to route to our distributor (NorthStar Distribution) for reconciliation. Please include the distributor's supplier code: NSD-7782, and route invoices to ap@northstardist.com.

3) Evidence for margin: our auditors ask for an evidence table that shows how the partner margin is calculated per-sku and any historical examples if available — a simple spreadsheet is fine (channel_margin_evidence.xlsx).

4) Marketplace listing: confirm whether Redwood will publish the offer as a private listing (visible only to CloudFort) or as a public listing once the deal closes. We prefer private listing initially.

5) Contract redlines: we have a few standard redlines around data residency and termination for convenience — I can attach our redline package if needed.

Please send the channel evidence and an invoice routing note. If you can provide those by EOD Thursday (your timezone), we can accelerate internal approvals.

Thanks,
Maria Garcia
Director of Procurement | CloudFort
maria.garcia@cloudfort.com

Attachment: cloudfort_po_template.docx (we included this earlier)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Private offer & partner pass-through plan for CloudFort

Connor / Irene —

Looping you in on CloudFort procurement reply (quoted above). They require: partner margin displayed as a separate invoice line, invoices routed to NorthStar (NSD-7782 / ap@northstardist.com), and a spreadsheet with margin evidence. They want a private marketplace listing.

Proposed quick win to keep the deal moving: 
- Confirm we can show an explicit partner margin line and route invoices to the distributor. Finance likes to avoid carving up the invoice model, but this is pass-through so should be operationally OK.
- Offer we give: 20% gross discount off list plus an 8% partner margin pass-through line (8% of list price). That leaves net economics: list $380k -> 20% discount = $304k -> partner margin (8% of $380k = $30.4k) -> net payable $273.6k to Redwood (numbers to be validated by finance).
- Attachments to produce: channel_margin_evidence.xlsx (row-level per-sku calc) + invoice_routing_note.txt that explains API/EDI routing to NorthStar. Also confirm private listing in our marketplace playbook (marketplace_listing_playbook.pdf).

Questions for you both: 
1) Connor — finance OK with 8% pass-through as a visible line and still count revenue as net of partner margin? If not, what's the operational approach?
2) Irene — legal: any concerns on private listing and the redlines CloudFort may send (data residency, termination)?

If we respond with the evidence + routing note by tomorrow EOD, Maria said procurement will move to finance the same day. Happy to jump on a 15-minute call with you both before sending.

Thanks,
Priya

> On 2028-06-21 13:45 Maria Garcia wrote:
> > Appreciate the quick turnaround ... (see original)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@cloudfort.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-23T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer & partner pass-through plan for CloudFort

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the clarity. Confirming Redwood can meet the procurement asks: 

- Invoice format: yes, we will provide an invoice that shows gross list, Redwood discount, an explicit "partner margin" line, and net payable. The partner margin will be recorded as pass-through and routed to your distributor.
- Distributor routing: we'll route invoices to NorthStar Distribution and include supplier code NSD-7782; AP delivery address will be ap@northstardist.com. Please confirm there's no special EDI requirement beyond email routing.
- Channel evidence: attached is a short SKU-level spreadsheet that breaks down list, discount, proposed margin percentage, and absolute partner margin amounts (channel_margin_evidence.xlsx).
- Marketplace listing: we will set up a private listing for CloudFort initially and make it visible to your account only. After your procurement sign-off we can move to publish more broadly if you request. See our internal playbook attached for timelines (marketplace_listing_playbook.pdf).

Next steps: 
1) Maria — if the attached evidence looks good please confirm and we'll send a revised private offer (final) with the invoice routing note and DocuSign link this afternoon.
2) Priya / Irene — attaching invoice_routing_note.txt and the evidence file; legal note: Irene, CloudFort mentioned a small set of redlines (data residency + termination for convenience). If you can advise any non-starters today, we'll flag them to Priya before counter-signing.

We aim to deliver the final DocuSign package within the day once we receive procurement confirmation.

Best regards,
Connor O'Brien
Head of Deals | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0124

Attachments: channel_margin_evidence.xlsx, invoice_routing_note.txt, marketplace_listing_playbook.pdf
